title: Continuous close
description: Continuously monitors close readiness and surfaces evidence-backed accounting and finance exceptions for review.

unmatched_bank_activity.title: Unmatched bank activity
unmatched_bank_activity.description: Bank statement activity remains unmatched to ledger transactions.

reconciliation_difference.title: Reconciliation difference
reconciliation_difference.description: An in-progress bank reconciliation does not agree with its statement balance.

stale_accounting_documents.title: Stale accounting documents
stale_accounting_documents.description: Draft or pending accounting documents have remained unfinished beyond the configured age.

missing_approved_budget.title: No approved budget
missing_approved_budget.description: Finance monitoring cannot compare actuals because no approved budget is available.

unfavorable_budget_variance.title: Unfavorable budget variance
unfavorable_budget_variance.description: Actual performance is materially worse than the approved budget.

period_revenue_decline.title: Revenue decline
period_revenue_decline.description: Revenue declined materially from the prior completed accounting period.

gross_margin_decline.title: Gross margin decline
gross_margin_decline.description: Gross margin fell beyond the configured threshold from the prior completed period.

reports.title: Agent reports
reports.description: Open a generated brief or export it as PDF.
reports.empty: No generated reports match these filters.

analysis.title: Agent analysis
analysis.evidenceNotice: Model-generated analysis is grounded in the linked records and remains subject to review.

empty.title: No findings yet
empty.description: Enable an agent and run its first scan. Cleared conditions are resolved automatically on later scans.

details.noEvidence: This finding is based on a missing prerequisite, so there are no source records to display.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this finding
dismiss.description: Record why this valid detector result should not remain in the active queue.

feedback.actionFailed: The finding could not be updated.
